issue_context.title: Feature: Metadata editing - Audio file album cover modification
issue_context.body:
### What's the Problem?

Currently even in the standard file explorer one is not able to edit the album cover image in various types of audio files

### Solution/Idea

Once metadata editing is implemented, in the same area add the option to replace the album cover when a format is compatible (ex. mp3, aac, .flac)

Optional - Have a preview of the image in the metadata entry area

### Requirements
- Dim album cover when hovering over it with mouse (referring to the properties page)
- On hover, display "edit" icon in the center of the photo
- Clicking the image should open a file picker and allow the user to select a different photo
- Support updating multiple files at a time
